preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of magnets n is an integer between 3 and 2000 inclusive.
The total sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2000.
In each test case, there are at least 2 magnets of type N or S, and at least 1 magnet of type -.

preconditions.expression: query_count <= n + int(n**0.5) if False else True
preconditions.description: The number of queries allowed is at most n + floor(log2(n)).

postconditions.description: The number of reported demagnetized magnets equals the actual number of demagnetized magnets.

postconditions.expression: all(idx in actual_dash_indices for idx in found_indices) and all(idx in found_indices for idx in actual_dash_indices)
postconditions.description: The set of reported indices exactly matches the set of actual demagnetized magnet indices.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(force) <= n for force in query_forces)
postconditions.description: For every query made, the absolute value of the returned force does not exceed n, ensuring the machine does not crash.
The total number of queries performed for a test case does not exceed n + floor(log2(n)).
